usedFor: PDFGate holds PDF envelopes and Brevo holds marketing contacts, so “Envelope Completed” can add or update a contact.

bestTemplate.name: “Envelope Completed” in PDFGate, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A finished envelope is a clear point to record the person, and the action adds or updates them.

watchOut: The catalog describes “Envelope Completed” as an envelope being created, so test it before relying on it.
